purpose: Reduce task-irrelevant orientation variance across AI systems entering the JosephJMWalker-MBA GitHub portfolio.
invariants: A named repository routes to its own canonical source first.
Portfolio summaries do not outrank repository-local authority.
Shared vocabulary does not imply shared ontology, runtime, or merger.
Broaden context only when the task requires it.
If orientation is insufficient, report insufficient orientation rather than guessing.

routes.when: Comparison, consolidation, duplication, prior art, or portfolio-level strategy.
action: read canonical source of every named project

routes.when: Understanding, interpretation, memory, intent, continuity, handoff, provider/session replacement.
Evidence, provenance, public records, regulated review, professional evidence, agreements, physical-asset evidence.
Measurement, preregistration, falsification, benchmarking, controlled comparison, model/system evaluation.
Multi-model architecture, interoperability, coordination, provider independence, cross-system governance, agentic collaboration.
Consulting, process redesign, business operations, commerce, enterprise systems, applied analytics.
Film, publishing, performance, music, live events, creative collaboration, production continuity.
Hardware continuity, bounded missions, field execution, physical systems, resilience, device lifecycle.
Public challenge, bounded contribution, reproduction, consequential decision environments, institutional coordination.
Current status, next work, operational state.
No route fits or more than one branch remains plausible.
action: read only candidate identity entries in PORTFOLIO_ORIENTATION.md
avoid full portfolio sweep unless necessary
